body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> AMD (www.amd.com) unveiled it's new integrated processor, the 'AMD Fusion APU (Accelerated Processing Units)' with 4 vendor's sampe laptops. according to AMD, all of the laptops are operating in 18 watts equipped with AMD E series APU.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
